notes.title: Shattered Bride - Update notes for 22. Jun.
notes.content:
[p]Hello there!

After monitoring the feedback and seeing the issues ourselves, we decided to act quickly and efficiently. This update focuses on a few of the major issues, but there is still work to be done. We’ve also added some small changes to freshen up the gameplay, making it feel fresh to start a new run—or even to route for a speedrun. We will continue monitoring feedback and working to fix issues in the game.

[/p][h2]Update content[/h2][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Fixed few typing errors
[/p][/*][*][p] Added difficulty to Bright District
[/p][/*][*][p] Changed key position in Bright District
[/p][/*][*][p] Changed lighting in the Cathedral steps
[/p][/*][*][p] Changed lighting in the Catherdal
[/p][/*][*][p] Added liveliness into first and last parts of Bright District
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed texture missing in Upper City windowsill
[/p][/*][*][p] Added destructible objects around Undercity and Bright District
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a worker to tutorial
[/p][/*][/list]
